result.brief: 提出免训练的选择性空间记忆控制器，用位姿-外观图动态评估观测可替代性，在固定预算下提升长时序相机控制视频生成的场景一致性。
result.reason: Training-free selective spatial memory controller for long-horizon camera-controlled video generation, improving FVD/LPIPS under fixed memory budget; directly serves long-video generation and persistent world-model memory.
